name: Melilla

flag.description: A light blue field with Melilla's coat of arms in the centre: a crowned shield flanked by the two Pillars of Hercules, under a scroll bearing a Latin motto.
flag.symbolism: The coat of arms comes from the Dukes of Medina Sidonia, whose forces took Melilla for Spain in 1497; the Pillars of Hercules are the old symbol of the Strait of Gibraltar.

hook: Melilla is a busy crowned shield between two white columns on a plain sky-blue field.
trivia: The motto Praeferre patriam liberis parentem decet, "a parent should put the homeland before his children", comes from the house of Medina Sidonia.
The coat of arms was granted by King Alfonso XIII in 1913; the flag itself became official with Melilla's autonomy statute in 1995.
